nodes.name: AuthProvider
nodes.description: SolidJS context provider that manages AT Protocol authentication state. Wraps session initialization and exposes agent, loading, and signOut.

nodes.name: useAuth
nodes.description: Hook to access authentication context (session, agent, loading, signOut) from within AuthProvider.

nodes.name: createAgent
nodes.description: Creates an AT Protocol Agent from an OAuth session for making authenticated API calls.

nodes.name: getOAuthClient
nodes.description: Singleton that returns the BrowserOAuthClient configured for AT Protocol loopback development. Handles localhost redirect URI setup.

nodes.name: initSession
nodes.description: Initializes OAuth session from stored credentials. Returns existing session or null if not logged in.

nodes.name: signIn
nodes.description: Initiates OAuth sign-in flow by redirecting to the AT Protocol authorization endpoint.

nodes.name: cloneStem
nodes.signature: (agent: Agent, stemUri: string) => Promise<{ uri: string; cid: string; }>
nodes.description: Copies an external stem to the user's own PDS. Returns existing reference if already owned.

nodes.name: createStemRecord
nodes.description: Creates a stem record with the uploaded blob and metadata (duration, type, mimeType).

nodes.name: deleteOrphanedStems
nodes.description: Finds and deletes stems not referenced by any project. Returns list of deleted URIs.

nodes.name: deleteProject
nodes.description: Deletes a project record. Does not delete associated stems (they may be shared).

nodes.name: deleteStem
nodes.description: Deletes a single stem record from the user's repository.

nodes.name: getProject
nodes.description: Fetches a project record from AT Protocol by URI. Validates against projectValidators schema.

nodes.name: getProjectByRkey
nodes.description: Fetches a project by record key, optionally resolving a handle to DID first.

nodes.name: getStem
nodes.description: Fetches a stem record from AT Protocol by URI. Validates against stemValidators schema.

nodes.name: getStemBlob
nodes.description: Fetches the actual video/audio blob data for a stem record.

nodes.name: isStemSource
nodes.description: Type guard that checks if a clip source references an AT Protocol stem record.

nodes.name: listProjects
nodes.description: Lists all projects for the authenticated user's repository.

nodes.name: listStems
nodes.description: Lists all stem URIs in the user's repository.

nodes.name: parseAtUri
nodes.signature: (uri: string) => { repo: string; collection: string; rkey: string; }
nodes.description: Parses an AT Protocol URI into repo, collection, and rkey components.

nodes.name: publishProject
nodes.signature: (agent: Agent, project: Project, clipBlobs: Map<string, { blob: Blob; duration: number }>) => Promise<import("/Users/bigmistqke/Documents/GitHub/eddy/packages/app/src/lib/atproto/crud").RecordRef>
nodes.description: Publishes a project by uploading all local recordings as stems and creating the project record. Clones external stems to own PDS.

nodes.name: resolveHandle
nodes.description: Resolves a Bluesky handle to its DID using the AT Protocol API.

nodes.name: uploadBlob
nodes.description: Uploads a blob to the user's PDS and returns the blob reference.

nodes.name: createDebugInfo
nodes.description: Exposes player state on window.__EDDY_DEBUG__ for browser console debugging. Provides getState() for inspecting playback status.

nodes.name: buildSegments
nodes.description: Builds time-sorted segments from clip transition points. Each segment contains all placements active during that time range.

nodes.name: calculateGridViewport

nodes.description: Calculates the viewport rectangle for a grid cell at the given index, accounting for columns, rows, gap, and padding.

nodes.name: calculateStackViewport
nodes.description: Returns a full-canvas viewport for stacked layout where all members overlap at full size.

nodes.name: collectClipInfos

nodes.name: getActivePlacements

nodes.name: getNextTransition
nodes.description: Finds the next segment boundary after a given time, returning which placements start/end.

nodes.name: getPlacementsInRange

nodes.name: Callback
nodes.description: OAuth callback route that completes sign-in flow. Redirects to home after a brief delay.

nodes.name: EditorRoute
nodes.description: Editor route wrapper that passes handle and rkey params to the Editor component for loading projects.

nodes.name: Home
nodes.description: Home page showing hero section with New Project link and list of user's existing projects with delete functionality.

nodes.name: audioDataToFrameData
nodes.description: Converts WebCodecs AudioData to planar Float32Array format expected by the muxer. Handles both planar and interleaved audio formats.

nodes.name: copyVideoFrameToBuffer
nodes.signature: (frame: VideoFrame) => Promise<{ buffer: ArrayBuffer; format: VideoPixelFormat; codedWidth: number; codedHeight: number; }>
nodes.description: Copies a VideoFrame's pixel data to an ArrayBuffer and closes the frame. Returns format, dimensions, and buffer for muxer.

nodes.name: readPreviewStream
nodes.description: Continuously reads frames from a preview stream (camera) and stores the latest for rendering. Runs until stream ends or is cancelled.

nodes.name: setFrame
nodes.description: Stores a VideoFrame for a clipId, closing any previous frame. Used by playback workers to send frames for compositing.

nodes.name: updateRenderStats
nodes.signature: (time: number, frame: VideoFrame | null | undefined, placement: Placement, isPreview: boolean) => void
nodes.description: Tracks frame rendering statistics including dropped, stale, and rendered counts. Detects stale frames by comparing timestamps and durations.

nodes.name: copyFrameToBuffer

nodes.description: Copies a VideoFrame to ArrayBuffer format for muxer. Debug version of capture worker utility.

nodes.name: addFrame
nodes.description: Queues a frame for encoding and triggers queue processing.

nodes.name: init
nodes.description: Initializes the muxer with format info. Creates mediabunny Output if not pre-initialized.

nodes.name: processQueue
nodes.description: Processes the frame queue by encoding each frame through mediabunny's VideoSampleSource.

nodes.name: addAudioFrame
nodes.description: Queues an audio frame for encoding via the muxer's audio pipeline.

nodes.name: addVideoFrame
nodes.description: Queues a video frame for encoding and updates scheduler with queue depth for backpressure signaling.

nodes.name: createAudioDecoder
nodes.description: Factory that creates a WebCodecs AudioDecoder handle for a demuxer's audio track. Provides decode(), decodeAll(), flush(), reset(), and close() methods with Promise-based AudioData output.

nodes.name: isAudioCodecSupported
nodes.description: Checks if a specific audio codec string (e.g., 'opus', 'mp4a.40.2') is supported by WebCodecs AudioDecoder.

nodes.name: isAudioDecoderSupported
nodes.description: Checks if the WebCodecs AudioDecoder API is available in the current environment.

nodes.name: createDemuxer
nodes.description: Factory that creates a demuxer for extracting video and audio samples from media containers. Wraps mediabunny's Input/EncodedPacketSink for sample access and keyframe seeking.

nodes.name: packetToSample
nodes.description: Converts a mediabunny EncodedPacket to the normalized DemuxedSample format with timestamps in seconds.

nodes.name: parseAudioTrack
nodes.description: Extracts AudioTrackInfo metadata (codec, sample rate, channels, duration) from a mediabunny InputAudioTrack.

nodes.name: parseVideoTrack
nodes.description: Extracts VideoTrackInfo metadata (codec, dimensions, duration) from a mediabunny InputVideoTrack.

nodes.name: createMuxer
nodes.description: Factory that creates a video/audio muxer for encoding frames to WebM format. Uses mediabunny for progressive encoding with configurable video (VP8/VP9/AV1) and audio (Opus/Vorbis) codecs.

nodes.name: createVideoDecoder
nodes.description: Factory that creates a WebCodecs VideoDecoder handle for a demuxer's video track. Provides decode(), decodeAll(), flush(), reset(), and close() methods with Promise-based frame output.

nodes.name: isVideoCodecSupported
nodes.description: Checks if a specific video codec string (e.g., 'vp9', 'avc1.42E01E') is supported by WebCodecs VideoDecoder.

nodes.name: isVideoDecoderSupported
nodes.description: Checks if the WebCodecs VideoDecoder API is available in the current environment.

nodes.name: createCompositor
nodes.description: Factory that creates a WebGL-based video compositor for an OffscreenCanvas. Renders VideoFrames with viewport positioning using texture caching and provides frame capture for recording.

nodes.name: createVideoTexture
nodes.description: Creates a WebGL texture with standard video sampling settings (clamp-to-edge wrapping, linear filtering).

nodes.name: viewportToWebGL
nodes.description: Converts a viewport from layout coordinates (y=0 at top) to WebGL coordinates (y=0 at bottom) for correct rendering.

nodes.name: getAudioContext
nodes.description: Singleton that returns the shared AudioContext instance, creating it on first access.

nodes.name: resumeAudioContext
nodes.description: Resumes the AudioContext if suspended (required after user gesture in browsers). Returns immediately if already running.

nodes.name: createAudioPipeline
nodes.description: Factory that creates an audio pipeline with gain and stereo pan nodes for a single audio source. Connects through the master mixer for centralized volume control.

nodes.name: getMasterMixer
nodes.description: Singleton that provides the master audio mixer with volume control and output routing. Supports switching between direct AudioContext output and MediaStream output to work around Chrome recording bugs.

nodes.name: createDecoder
nodes.description: Factory that creates a managed VideoDecoder wrapper with automatic error recovery. Uses a synchronous decode + drain pattern for performance: decode() queues work without Promise overhead, drainFrames() returns accumulated frames.

nodes.name: configsMatch
nodes.signature: (a: VideoDecoderConfig | null, b: VideoDecoderConfig | null) => boolean
nodes.description: Checks if two VideoDecoderConfigs are equivalent (same codec, width, height) to determine if the decoder can be reused between clips.

nodes.name: createPlayback
nodes.description: Factory that creates a video playback engine managing demuxing, decoding, and frame buffering. Coordinates the decode pipeline using mediabunny for demuxing, maintains a ring buffer of decoded frames, and outputs VideoFrames via callback at the correct timing during playback.

nodes.name: packetToSample
nodes.description: Converts a mediabunny EncodedPacket to the DemuxedSample format expected by the decoder.

nodes.name: alignUp

nodes.name: frameToData
nodes.description: Converts a VideoFrame to a serializable FrameData object for buffering. Copies pixel data to an ArrayBuffer with GPU-compatible 128-byte alignment and closes the original frame.
